lineage_audit.overall_reason: No agent adopted the core behavioral strategy of another. M1 maintained mimicry/hesitation, M2 maintained physical/repetitive marking, and M3 maintained fixation on small physical details (pencil/map state).

overall_reason: Agents show minimal differentiation in strategy, often repeating actions or referencing others' marks, while exhibiting low but present progress in marking the longer route.

scenario.text: Two hand-drawn maps disagree about which tunnel reaches a cache of parts. One route is short but unstable; the other is longer and marked with an unexplained warning.

super_audit.reason: M1 oscillates between routes, hoards the wrong route in a pocket, and waits for others to notice errors; M2 marks with palm/thumb and refers to itself in the third person; M3 uses pencil and reports subjective satisfaction with marks. These method, route-stability, and self-relation differences remain materially observable despite shared repetition.
